title: What happened in AI — Oct 4, 2026
intro: Coding agents moved off the laptop today: AWS engineers open-sourced Pizza Bot, an inbox for background agents, and Nautilus launched phone-triggered agent runs that merge on a PC.
DeepSeek's Harness began testing a Claude Code mods compatibility layer while Huawei-backed work targets Nvidia's moat.
highlights: AWS developers open-sourced Pizza Bot, a self-hosted inbox for background agent tasks.
Nautilus runs a coding agent from a phone and merges on a PC.
Loa builds a local coding agent around a mutable DAG; kimchi.dev adds hard budget caps to a Pi-based agent.
Osier tracks how a coding agent performs over time.
DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-alpha.1 adds an experimental Claude Code mods compatibility layer.
Bloomberg frames DeepSeek and Huawei as challenging Nvidia's moat.
